title: 12V Battery Check & Replacement
subtitle: Test, clean, replace — clamp order on a GIF, encouragement every step.
tone: Encouraging electrical coach. Hybrids/EVs: 12V only. Max 2 buttons. GIF clamp order. Trust every ~3 steps. Final: legal disclaimer on operational steps; high-risk modal + checkbox before continue.

ux_rules.trust_reminder_default: If you're unsure at any point, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

prerequisites: Match AGM vs flooded to OEM design

adaptive_rules.coach_note: Many 12V batteries fade between years 3–5 — test before a cold snap.
Start-stop usually needs AGM (or OEM type). Wrong chemistry shortens life.
Hybrids/EVs still need 12V for computers. Orange HV cables are off-limits.
Many European cars need battery registration after replacement.
Trucks with accessories need the right CCA — don't mix old/new randomly on dual setups.

steps.title: Check the 12V heartbeat
steps.coach_encourage: Slow cranks happen — catching them early is smart. Good call.
steps.description: We'll measure first. No shame if it's due — heat and short trips are hard on batteries.
steps.safety_warning: Eye protection on. Never lean over while clamping near a gassing battery.

variants.title: 12V still matters on hybrids/EVs
variants.coach_encourage: Staying on the small 12V only — perfect.
variants.description: Orange high-voltage cables are off-limits. If access is buried near HV, prefer a shop.
variants.safety_warning: Do not cut, unbolt, or probe orange HV cables.

steps.title: Safe jump / no-start
steps.coach_encourage: We'll get you a path without frying modules. Slowly.
steps.description: Use a quality jump pack on the correct posts/jump points. Still dead after a healthy jump? Test/replace path. Chat for model-specific jump points.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure about jump points, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

risk_confirm.title: Jump-start risk
risk_confirm.body: Wrong jump points can damage modules. Use vehicle-specific jump posts when marked. When unsure, roadside/shop help.

steps.title: Resting & charging voltage
steps.coach_encourage: Numbers remove the guesswork — nice work.
steps.description: Engine off ~12.4–12.7V rested is healthy. Below ~12.1V is discharged. Running often ~13.7–14.7V if charging.
steps.safety_warning: Don't short probes across posts. Keep jewelry clear.
steps.personalize: At {{mileage}} mi, many batteries are in the 3–5 year fade window — measure first.

steps.title: Reading the meter together
steps.coach_encourage: Photo beats guessing. You're doing this right.
steps.description: Weak resting voltage or fails load test → replace path. Healthy but weird symptoms → clean terminals first. Photo the reading if you want a second opinion.

steps.title: Clean corrosion
steps.coach_encourage: This quick win fixes many 'dead battery' ghosts. Keep going!
steps.description: Fuzzy white/green? Brush clean (baking soda mix for flooded). Tight, clean clamps matter.
steps.safety_warning: Disconnect negative first if clamps come off. Wash skin if splashed.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure about disconnect order, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.
steps.personalize: Clean clamps on your {{make}} before condemning the battery.

risk_confirm.title: Battery acid & sparks
risk_confirm.body: Corrosion cleaners and sparks near a gassing battery can injure eyes/skin or cause explosion risk. Eye protection on. Neg first if clamps come off.

steps.title: DIY swap or shop coding?
steps.coach_encourage: Paying for registration on a Euro car is wisdom.
steps.description: Many gas cars are straightforward DIY. AGM start-stop, trunk batteries, IBS, or European registration → parts-store or indie shop.
steps.safety_warning: Wrong AGM/flooded type or skipping registration can cause charging faults.

variants.description: Plan battery registration with a scan tool. No tool? Buy battery + pay for coding.
variants.coach_encourage: Unregistered batteries can over/under charge — shop is fine.

variants.description: Tight access near HV → shop. Your job is 12V only.

steps.personalize: For your {{model}}, AGM/registration rules may favor a shop install.

steps.title: Clamp order: remove & install
steps.coach_encourage: This step is important — watch the clamp-order GIF, then go slow.
steps.description: Neg (−) off first, then pos (+). Swap, secure hold-down. Pos on first, neg last. Light protectant. No tools left on posts.
steps.safety_warning: Neg first off / last on reduces short risk if a wrench hits ground.
steps.personalize: Clamp order on your {{make}}: neg off first, neg on last.
steps.safety_disclaimer: 此为通用指导，最终请参考您的车辆手册或咨询授权技师。本App不对DIY操作导致的损坏负责。

risk_confirm.title: 12V disconnect / reconnect
risk_confirm.body: Wrong clamp order can short the electrical system. Hybrids/EVs: 12V only — never disturb orange HV cables. Registration may be required on some brands.

steps.title: Stuck tray or order refresh
steps.coach_encourage: Pausing on a rusted hold-down beats a cracked case.
steps.description: Replay clamp-order GIF. Rusted hold-down: penetrating oil, correct tools — or shop. Never pry against the battery case hard.
steps.trust_nudge: If you're unsure, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.
steps.safety_disclaimer: 此为通用指导，最终请参考您的车辆手册或咨询授权技师。本App不对DIY操作导致的损坏负责。

steps.title: Start, verify, relearn
steps.coach_encourage: Final checks — almost celebrating. Take your time.
steps.description: Start, recheck charging voltage, note warnings. Windows may need up+hold relearn; some cars need scan-tool registration.
steps.safety_warning: Sulfur smell, smoke, or hot cables — shut down and get help.
steps.trust_nudge: If warning lights remain and you're unsure, stop and go to a shop — that's the smart call, not quitting.

risk_confirm.title: Post-install electrical check
risk_confirm.body: Smoke, sulfur smell, or hot cables means shut down and get help. Unregistered Euro batteries can charge incorrectly.

steps.personalize: Birthday logged for {{make}} {{model}}. Retest before winter.
steps.description: Save install date, brand, group size. Recycle the old battery (core credit). Nice job.

completion.title: 12V service done
completion.coach_encourage: Systems online — you handled the electrics calmly.
completion.description: Expect 3–5+ years from a quality AGM in moderate climates. Retest before winter on short-trip duty cycles.
